notes: Window filter is on MAX(orderline.LastEditedWhen, order.LastEditedWhen): (@LastCutoff, @NewCutoff]. Order 1's effective timestamp is 2020-01-20 (line wins); order 2's is 2020-02-20 (order wins). ORDER BY OrderID.

cases.name: jan-window
cases.why: Jan window returns order 1 only, and its effective timestamp is the ORDER-LINE's (line-wins arm of the CASE).

cases.name: feb-window
cases.why: Feb window returns order 2 only; its effective timestamp is the ORDER's (order-wins arm). Order 2 also has BackorderOrderID set and NULL PickingCompletedWhen (the CAST(NULL AS date) picked-key branch).

cases.name: both-months
cases.why: Wide window returns both orders, ordered by OrderID -> proves ordering and both ROUND arithmetics (250.00/37.50/287.50 and 300.00/30.00/330.00).

cases.name: empty-window
cases.why: A window before any edit returns nothing -> empty result.

cases.name: upper-boundary-inclusive
cases.why: NewCutoff exactly equals order 1's effective timestamp (2020-01-20 09:00:00). The upper bound is <=, so order 1 is INCLUDED. Guards the boundary against a > / >= swap.

cases.name: lower-boundary-exclusive
cases.why: LastCutoff exactly equals order 1's effective timestamp. The lower bound is >, so order 1 is EXCLUDED and only order 2 remains. Guards the boundary against a < / <= swap.
